Developer experience

From idea to production in minutes

Get started with the CLI, explore the docs, and ship globally—all in one workflow.

Quick Start
# Install Wrangler CLI
$ npm install -g wrangler

# Create a new project
$ wrangler init my-app

# Deploy to production
$ wrangler deploy
✓ Published my-app
  https://my-app.workers.dev

Multiple Languages

JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and WASM. Use the language you already know.

Pay for What You Use

CPU-time based billing, not wall-clock time. Only pay for the compute you actually consume.

Zero Cold Starts

V8 isolates mean your code starts executing immediately. No containers, no waiting.
